title: Prove exact Gaussian phase-window boundary counts (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped counting proof with exact finite corroboration for the unchanged Gaussian physical-period/phase-cell carve from Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml's [PR3851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3851).

```diff
- n_B <= 4mw/d + 12w
+ n_B <= min(m, 2w ceil((t-s)(m-1)/s) + 8w)
+ exact n_B and long-piece counts from the two endpoint cells
```

The formula handles signed lifted starts, clipping and physical period seams using a fixed number of integer operations. Complete middle cells are long under the source production spacing hypotheses. The written proof covers arbitrary window lengths; the smaller allowance applies to windows of at most one period, including the source domain. This is a new accounting result, not an audit of the predecessor or a changed execution. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

Only `research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count/` is added. The exact formula, proof, source pins and executable are at [head c2b0abf710f4452884c2fbf5b8103b47eb9b3c07](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c2b0abf710f4452884c2fbf5b8103b47eb9b3c07/research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count).

Credit Jose Manuel for PR3851's physical producer/consumer, carve and complete tariff; Dugongue / PR5566 for the related complete Beatty-run viewpoint; Vlado Vojdanovski, RaD/hipotures, Chafik Boukhalfa / PR481/486/489 and the retained physical-word/Gaussian lineage. Classical floor arithmetic is credited as classical. The new contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- Before: the source caller uses the coarse allowance. At s=480,t=485,w=3,d=48,m=384 it is 132 boundary rows. After: the proved allowance is 48 and the exact count is 30, from pieces of lengths 48,96,96,96,48. The actual carve is unchanged.
- Every one of 1,459,710 literal windows across 319 parameter configurations agrees with the closed form. All 722,570 one-period bound checks, 144 seam/translation fixtures, six semantic controls and eleven domain rejections pass. Both registered modes produce identical generated source-hash receipts.
- The complete source tariff includes interior rows and long pieces. Holding the common target/core terms and the five long pieces fixed, its old sufficient subtotal is 10120, the new bound gives 9616 and the exact count gives 9508. These are accounting allowances, not a runtime or executed-call reduction. The substitution has the required nonnegative coefficient for w>=3; w=1,2 are explicitly excluded from that upper-bound substitution.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized scientific checks took 2.14 seconds each; the complete registered pair took 4.55 seconds, below both 120-second per-command limits. Committed bytes and full declared source history pass. The official nine-file package/input export passes integrity and explicit-input coverage. Both read-only Git-free replays pass with all ten exported-file hashes unchanged. Actual source-byte corruption and seam, endpoint and threshold mutations reject.

Reproduce from the repository root with the CPython 3.12 standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the local path. Expected markers: `PASS_GAUSSIAN_PHASE_BOUNDARY_COUNT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The result assumes floor(s/(2(t-s)))>4w, which follows from the stated production spacing conditions. The finite witness is not an asymptotic production payload. No encoded count planner, reduced backing allocation, changed numerical execution, native/physical supplier, complete tensor/setup invoice or multiplication theorem is supplied. Source numerical and physical correctness remain inherited premises. All selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific verifier, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker was run; no local registered command remains unrun. An external static analyzer was unavailable. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can the encoded preparation planner consume the exact counts before allocating boundary banks? Bind one actual Window preparation, charge encoded divisions and descriptor access, and compare retained backing and the whole setup/online bill. That changed physical implementation is not supplied here. Research stopped at the first verified accounting improvement.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected all 15 other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this physical Gaussian carve's phase-window boundary-row count or reports a competing value for this instance. No additional computations checked their results.

- [PR6265](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6265) changes encoded Machin coefficient setup; it does not count or change Gaussian phase-window boundary rows.
- [PR6255](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6255) changes the carry-graded layout for box convolution, with a possible weighted Gaussian consumer; its representation count is different from this carve's boundary-row count.
- [PR6263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6263) speeds an order-17 Clifford checker using Gaussian-rational matrix products; it does not study the physical Gaussian window carve.

The merged PR3851 implementation and PR5566 inverse remain credited predecessors. Targeted live searches for PR3851 and Beatty/phase-window counts found no additional same-object open work. Sparse notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside overlap coverage.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `c2b0abf710f4452884c2fbf5b8103b47eb9b3c07` in [run 41049144888](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41049144888): `plan` in 4m34s and `replay (research/gaussian-phase-boundary-count)` in 1m38s. The checks were read once after completion; run metadata confirms the matching head, completed status and successful conclusion. Every registered command also passed locally.

Hosted replay certifies the registered automated checks within their stated scope. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed. No CI failure remains to report.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. One isolated research package and opt-in replay manifest.

**Blast Radius:** research. No shared implementation, predecessor credit, frozen input or selected-frontier file changes.

Advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19292015).
